name: DrumRack32
author: legsmechanical
description: Ableton Move's Drum Rack with 32 pads instead of 16, where any pad can also be a synthesised drum. Loads Move's own .ablpreset drum kits and plays them through a reconstruction of the same Drum Sampler voice (playback region, transpose/detune, A-H-D / A-S-R envelope, four filter types, velocity modulation, choke groups, Punch), and lets any pad play a SIMIAN or URCHIN drum model instead. Every pad has a Send A / Send B into the host's return buses.
